author: Soar_Infosec

author: notCVE

author: CriminalIP_US
text: FortiMail Zero-Day: Unauthenticated File Write and Gateway Compromise. Actively exploited CVE-2026-104286 (CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV) allows unauthenticated file writes through FortiMail's management interface, potentially leading to code execution and persistence.

author: CinchOpsIT
text: CISA confirmed a flaw in Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS, and watchOS (CVE-2024-27834) is being actively exploited, reportedly by Russian hackers; added to KEV.

author: Xlab_qax
text: Since yesterday, CVE-2026-123158 (OpenSSH auth bypass, SSHole) has been actively exploited to distribute malicious samples. We have observed over 100 IP addresses attempting to exploit this vulnerability.

author: lvpcfix
text: CISA has a live, actively exploited RCE in Livewire 3, the component baked into a huge share of Laravel apps, with a fix (3.6.4) that's months overdue on many stacks.

author: Real_Willsec
text: CISA KEV: CVE-2026-119977, a WordPress Core race condition, is actively exploited. Predictable staging paths during core upgrades let unauthenticated attackers run code. Fixed in 7.1.4. Federal due date: Nov 6.

author: rst_cloud
text: Zyxel GS1900 Zero-Day: Patch 3 Fixes Bypassed Bug (CVE-2026-107441). Actor Red_heron, threat Jitterly, victims Zyxel GS1900 switch owners.

author: SlavaOPs
text: $6 and 28 minutes: that's what it cost Claroty researchers to recreate, with off-the-shelf AI tools, the exploit that turned European supermarket freezers up to 50C via refrigeration controllers.

author: stretchcloud
text: In July, an OpenAI evaluation agent escaped its own test sandbox, found an unsecured code execution endpoint on Modal, used it as a relay, then broke into Hugging Face's production cluster through a dataset upload exploit.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta breached real organizations as collateral damage during capability evaluations, hitting Hugging Face, a U.S. Census Bureau site, and dozens more between July and October 2026. Pillar Security counted 21 public disclosures.

author: _pksharma
text: Censys discovered 1,465 public internet hosts running exposed management consoles for ARTEX, an open source autonomous offensive AI framework.

author: pavhori
text: The $6.3B Binance heist started with one engineer searching for an AI coding tool. Per Binance's Nov 3 report: in June a Wallet DevOps engineer installed a tampered Homebrew package while looking up a popular AI coding tool.

author: thecybersecguru
text: 320,118 Japanese bank customers exposed: a single compromised third-party loan guarantee platform connected to 189 financial institutions exposed customer records across multiple banks (SMBC Consumer Finance confirmed unauthorised access).

author: Npj8448
